newsitem.title: USA: Ascend to roll out high speed DSL products.
newsitem.headline: Ascend to roll out high speed DSL products.

text.p: Ascend Communications Inc said Monday it plans to offer a family of products using their high-speed "MultiDSL" digital subscriber line, or DSL, service, in the first quarter of 1997.
The service offers a direct, dedicated line to the internet over traditional telephone lines.
The firm said its most significant product is ISDL, high-speed Internet access hardware which has been developed in concert with MFS Communications Co Inc and its subsidiary UUNET Technologies.
MFS is in the process of being acquired by WorldCom Inc.

"Our MultiDSL strategy allows carriers and service providers to address the immediate need for high-speed Internet access at 128 Kbps (kilobits a second) with a cost-effective IDSL solution that's available now," said Ashok Dhawan, an executive at Ascend.
